europe_now.title: US Diplomatic Mission and Ceasefire Initiative
europe_now.summary: United States envoys have traveled to Moscow and Kyiv to advance a new diplomatic framework aimed at ending the ongoing conflict. Concurrently, Russian leadership has signed off on a temporary 72-hour halt in strikes targeting Kyiv.

sources.headline: Putin signs off on 72-hour ceasefire with Kyiv as US envoys visit
Putin orders 72-hour halt in strikes on Kyiv as Trump envoys arrive in Moscow

europe_now.title: UK Political Scandal and Investigations
europe_now.summary: Reform UK has experienced high-level departures among its senior officials following media investigations into potential breaches of election law and foreign donation regulations. The political developments surround ongoing scrutiny regarding party funding sources.

sources.headline: Two senior Reform UK officials resign as Farage faces fresh foreign donations scandal
‘Major potential breaches of British election law’: Inside Channel 4’s investigation into Reform UK

top_stories.title: German Regional Elections and Far-Right Momentum
top_stories.summary: The Alternative for Germany party is positioning itself for a historic state election performance as voters head to the polls. Observers note that the regional vote could grant the far-right formation its first major taste of executive power.

sources.headline: Germany: AfD eyes historic state election win
Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote

top_stories.title: Legal Proceedings Against the Tate Brothers in Romania
top_stories.summary: Judicial authorities in Romania have officially advanced indictments against the Tate brothers. The formal charges include human trafficking and additional sex-related crimes.
